newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiwa Sec says mulling support to unit.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa Sec says mulling support to unit.

text.p: Daiwa Securities Co Ltd said on Friday that it has been reviewing a restructuring programme for a non-bank affiliate.
However, it said in a statement that details have not been decided yet.

Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Friday that Daiwa Securities was considering providing financial support of about 100 billion yen to a non-bank affiliate in the year to March 31, 1997.
The paper said providing such support would reduce Daiwa's parent net profit to nil in 1996/97.
Daiwa, one of Japan's "Big Four" brokerages, does not issue profit forecasts.
It posted parent net profit of 43.69 billion yen in the business year ended March 31, 1996.
